title: socket.connect raises oserror when dragging a file into a record
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.0.2; operating system Ubuntu 24.04 LTS; server region us-
west-2.

## Steps

Steps to reproduce:
- With the log window open, start dragging a file into a record.
- Copy a path from a Windows machine into the settings.
- Watch the log for the traceback below.

## Expected

Expected dragging a file into a record to finish without errors.

## Actual

The failing path contains backslashes mixed with forward slashes. The settings
came from a Windows colleague, so the path has backslashes.

## Frequency

Reproduces only on the first run after login.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:46 in loop
lattice/ui/upload.py:40 in on_drop
lattice/io/upload.py:118 in send
lattice/net/socket.py:75 in connect
OSError: [Errno 101] Network is unreachable (host=us-west-2)
